list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') AS __text FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS warnings FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type') = 'Warning' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$'

SELECT count(*) AS events FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$'

SELECT CONCAT(json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type'), ' / ', json_extract_string(body, '$.object.reason')) AS reason, count(*) AS events FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type') REGEXP '^(${type:regex})$' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(timestamp) / 300) * 300) AS time, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT timestamp AS time, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type') AS type, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.reason') AS reason, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.kind') AS kind, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') AS namespace, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.name') AS name, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.note') AS note, json_extract_string(body, '$.object.deprecatedCount') AS count FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND CAST(log_attributes['k8s.resource.name'] AS VARCHAR) = 'events' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.type') REGEXP '^(${type:regex})$' AND json_extract_string(body, '$.object.regarding.namespace') REGEXP '^(${namespace:regex})$' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
